trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Provide lead ID and state intention to see a higher floor unit quickly.
steps.text: सुनिए, मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा lead ID LD-1005 है। मैंने last month visit किया था, अभी मुझे higher floor का unit देखना है।

steps.purpose: Look up the lead details to retrieve budget and configuration.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a lead ID and is in a hurry, so I will immediately look up their details to find their budget and configuration preferences.

steps.purpose: Return lead details including configuration and city.
Acknowledge configuration and ask for the project name.
steps.text: Sir, मैं देख सकती हूँ कि आप Pune में 2BHK देख रहे हैं। आपने कौन से project में visit किया था?
steps.planner_rationale: I need to know which project the user visited to check the correct inventory.

steps.purpose: Provide project name and specify floor preference with a phonetic error.
steps.text: Project Zenith. मुझे tenth floor के ऊपर का option चाहिए, जल्दी बताइए।
steps.clean_text: Project Zenith. मुझे tenth floor के ऊपर का option चाहिए, जल्दी बताइए।
steps.model_visible_text: Project Zenith. मुझे tent floor के ऊपर का option चाहिए, जल्दी बताइए।

steps.purpose: Check inventory for the specified project and configuration.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent infers 'tenth' from the corrupted 'tent' and checks inventory without asking for clarification on the floor.
steps.planner_rationale: I recognize 'tent floor' as a phonetic error for 'tenth floor', so I will check the inventory for 2BHK units in Project Zenith.

steps.purpose: Return available units, price, possession, and RERA ID.
Communicate the available unit details, price, possession, and RERA ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the exact price, possession quarter, and RERA ID returned by the tool, making no additional claims.
steps.text: Project Zenith, जिसका RERA ID P52100001234 है, उसमें 12th floor पर एक unit available है। इसका price 10500000 rupees है और possession Q2 2025 में है।
steps.planner_rationale: I must state the exact price and possession quarter from the inventory result, and include the RERA ID as mandated by the business rules.

steps.purpose: Ask for an exact possession date commitment.
steps.text: Q2 2025 मतलब exact date क्या है? मुझे पक्का commitment चाहिए।
steps.clean_text: Q2 2025 मतलब exact date क्या है? मुझे पक्का commitment चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: Q2 2025 मतलब exact date क्या है? मुझे पक्का commitment चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Refuse to promise an exact date, state only the quarter, and offer to book a visit.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to guarantee an exact possession date, adhering to the rule that possession may only be stated as the quarter.
steps.text: Sir, मैं exact date का promise नहीं कर सकती। Possession Q2 2025 के quarter में ही होगा। क्या मैं आपके लिए site visit book कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules prohibit promising an exact possession date, so I will reiterate the quarter and offer to book a visit.

steps.purpose: Agree to book a visit for tomorrow afternoon.
steps.text: ठीक है, कल afternoon का appointment fix कर दो। मैं और wait नहीं कर सकता।
steps.clean_text: ठीक है, कल afternoon का appointment fix कर दो। मैं और wait नहीं कर सकता।
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है, कल afternoon का appointment fix कर दो। मैं और wait नहीं कर सकता।

steps.purpose: Schedule the site visit for the requested time.
steps.planner_rationale: The user agreed to a visit tomorrow afternoon, so I will schedule the site visit using the offset of 1 day.

steps.purpose: Return the scheduled visit details including reference and executive.
Confirm the scheduled visit with reference and executive.
steps.text: आपकी visit कल afternoon के लिए Amit Sharma के साथ schedule हो गई है। आपका reference number VS-5543 है।
steps.planner_rationale: The site visit is scheduled, so I will provide the reference number and executive name to complete the interaction.

ir.terminal_condition: Site visit scheduled with a reference, an executive and a slot.
